`server-card-v1.schema.json` is the upstream Server Card extension's generated JSON Schema, pinned to commit [`526201bbc80231daa40ffcdecfc9da4e54e5dc93`](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/experimental-ext-server-card/blob/526201bbc80231daa40ffcdecfc9da4e54e5dc93/schema.json). The extension's `schema.ts` is its source of truth; this unmodified copy makes Storyden's contract test independent of network availability. Its Apache 2.0 license is in `LICENSE.server-card-apache-2.0`.
